Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: http://www.nbri.res.in.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CSIR Director Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://www.nbri.res.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR Director recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the CSIR Director recruitment is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Natural Sciences or a Master’s Degree in Engineering/Health/Medical Sciences. A Ph.D. is desirable for Engineering/Health/Medical Sciences specializations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Director position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Director post is between 45 years and 56 years. Age relaxation may be provided for exceptionally meritorious candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Director role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Director position will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 182,200 to Rs. 224,100 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CSIR Director recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, and send it along with necessary documents via post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this CSIR Director recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Director post?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Application/Nomination Review. Further details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Director position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Director position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the CSIR located?
faq.answer: The CSIR is recruiting for a Director position in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
